# PhaseX Laser Services

> Independent laser service company based in Parsippany, New Jersey, working on site
> across the United States and Canada. We evaluate, repair and modernize industrial, packaging and
> scientific laser equipment at component level, including machines that are out of
> warranty, out of support, or built by a company that no longer exists. PhaseX Laser
> Services is a registered DBA of CoreX Robotics Services LLC.

## What we are

- Independent third-party service provider. Not an authorized service center for any
  manufacturer, and we do not perform manufacturer warranty work. Brand and model names
  on our pages identify equipment only.
- Field service and bench repair. Every job starts with a written scope and a fixed
  evaluation fee quoted before anyone travels, and ends with a written report.
- Component-level work: boards repaired rather than only swapped, obsolete parts
  substituted with the differences documented, subsystems engineered out and replaced
  when repair is not the right answer.

## Two limits we state on every page

- We do not promise a specific repair before diagnosis.
- We do not certify equipment to original published specifications where the original
  acceptance data and the corresponding standards are unavailable. We document the
  measured condition before and after instead.

## Industrial laser service

- [Industrial laser services](https://phasexlaser.com/#services): laser cutting, welding,
  cleaning and cladding systems, robotic laser cells, tube and combination machines,
  coil-fed lines, automated load and unload systems.
- [Component-level work](https://phasexlaser.com/#components): laser sources, cutting
  heads, drive electronics, control systems.
- [Retrofit and modernization](https://phasexlaser.com/#retrofit): CO2 to fiber
  conversions, control system upgrades, source and cutting head replacement on legacy
  machines.

## Industrial laser service

- [Industrial laser service and repair](https://phasexlaser.com/industrial-laser-service/): the hub for
  industrial laser technical services. Cutting, welding, marking and engraving, cleaning, cladding, CO2
  systems, installation, commissioning and relocation, each as its own section, plus component-level
  repair scope and a repair-or-replace table.
- [Laser source repair](https://phasexlaser.com/industrial-laser-service/laser-source-repair/): fiber and
  CO2 sources, also called laser generators. No output, low power, protection trips, power supplies and
  driver electronics, delivery cables and connectors. IPG, Raycus, MAX Photonics, JPT, GW LaserTech,
  nLIGHT and more.
- [Laser cutting head repair](https://phasexlaser.com/industrial-laser-service/laser-cutting-head-repair/):
  collimators, focus modules, protective windows, nozzles and capacitive height sensing. Raytools,
  Precitec, WSX, BOCI, OSPRI, Laser Mechanisms, HIGHYAG.
- [Laser cutting machine repair](https://phasexlaser.com/industrial-laser-service/laser-cutting-machine-repair/):
  machine-down and performance work on flat-bed, tube, combination and coil-fed machines, CNC and drives,
  assist gas, extraction, chilling and safety circuits, including imported machines and machines whose
  builder no longer exists.
- [Laser retrofit and modernization](https://phasexlaser.com/industrial-laser-service/laser-retrofit/):
  control and drive chain replacement, source replacement, CO2 to fiber conversion, and the repair,
  retrofit or replace comparison stated in writing.

## Packaging and printing laser service

- [Packaging laser service hub](https://phasexlaser.com/packaging-laser-service/): an A to Z

  Cartes, AB Graphic, Kama, Bobst, eurolaser, Smag Graphique, Golden Laser.

  Domino, Videojet, Markem-Imaje, Macsa ID, Keyence, FOBA, Telesis, Matthews, Linx,
  Leibinger, REA JET, Koenig & Bauer Coding, Panasonic.
- [Gravure and rotary screen engraving](https://phasexlaser.com/packaging-laser-service/gravure-screen-engraving/):
  Hell HelioKlischograph, Daetwyler, Ohio Gravure Technologies, Schepers, SPGPrints,
  Think Laboratory, Kaspar Walter.

## Notes

- [Notes index](https://phasexlaser.com/blog/): short pieces by PhaseX Laser Services on
  identifying equipment and describing a fault usefully. No repair procedures, and no article
  diagnoses a machine from a single symptom.
- [The same flexo plate complaint, three different machines to look at](https://phasexlaser.com/blog/flexo-plate-imaging-lams-til-direct-engraving/): A shallow or inconsistent plate can come from the imager, the exposure step or the processor, and which of those exist at all depends on the platemaking route you run.
- [Is it a marking problem or an inspection problem? The answer changes the service call](https://phasexlaser.com/blog/co2-fiber-uv-coding-laser-service/): A code that a person can read and a code the vision system accepts are two different observations. Separating them, and naming the laser family and the substrate, is what makes a coder service request useful.
- [Machine, laser source, controller: three identities on one converting line](https://phasexlaser.com/blog/converting-machine-builder-laser-source-service/): The name on a converting machine, the laser source inside it and the controller on its operator panel are three separate pieces of information. Knowing which one you are looking at shortens a service request.
- [A sealed ultrafast laser is not an unrepairable one](https://phasexlaser.com/blog/ultrafast-laser-low-output-system-architecture/): Low output from an ultrafast system says little about which part failed, and a closed enclosure says nothing about whether it can be repaired. What helps is identifying the installed architecture.

## Planned maintenance

- [Preventive maintenance programs](https://phasexlaser.com/preventive-maintenance/): monthly and
  quarterly service programs for industrial, packaging and scientific equipment. Both are real visit
  cadences, not billing labels. The interval for each machine is set against its operating hours,
  environment, condition and the manufacturer's own stated requirements, so neither cadence is presented
  as a universal requirement. Deliverables are an equipment record, written findings after every visit,
  an open-items list with priorities and the next planned date. No service-level agreement, response-time
  commitment, uptime figure, certification or price is stated. Planned maintenance and corrective repair
  are separate decisions with separate approvals, and one-off service continues unchanged.

## Finding the right page from a symptom

- [Laser symptom index](https://phasexlaser.com/symptom-index/): what owners and operators
  actually describe, across packaging, industrial and scientific equipment, each entry linking to
  the section that covers that equipment. It is a route into the right page, not a diagnosis:
  no single symptom identifies a fault on this equipment, and the page says so.

## Requesting service

- [Evaluation request form](https://phasexlaser.com/scientific-laser-repair/intake/): one form for all three sectors, five required fields, equipment
  type, manufacturer, model, serial number, symptoms, measurements and photographs.

## Notes for anyone citing this site

- Laser safety: Class 4 work is planned under a project-specific written laser safety plan.
  On a customer site, final hazard analysis and approval stay with that facility's own
  safety function.
- We do not publish instrumentation as a fixed laboratory inventory. Measurement
  instruments for each job are named in that job's written proposal.
